verdict.rationale: Wrike documents built-in Wrike agents that users can set up to handle everyday tasks, including triaging, risk assessment and task execution. Wrike Copilot also answers questions and summarizes work inside the product. All evidence is marketing-level vendor copy. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how tasks are delegated to agents (scope, permissions, review/approval of agent actions), independent or hands-on corroboration that agents execute delegated tasks reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Build workflows with Wrike agents and let them handle your everyday tasks.
allowing teams to build custom AI agents that handle triaging, risk assessment, and task execution.
Wrike Copilot answers questions, summarizes work, and keeps your team moving
AI Essentials include AI content and editing, comment summary, board AI, mobile inbox prioritization, and NL automation rule generation.
